SERVICES AGREEMENT
This Agreement is made between Sundial Row Clinic (the Client) and Vellacott Tool & Die (the Supplier), and takes
effect on 1 February 2026.
Monthly fee: $2,563.72
Initial term: 36 months
1. Events beyond control
Neither party shall be liable for any failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control, provided that it gives
prompt written notice and takes all reasonable steps to resume performance. For the purposes of clause 1 the reference period is
7 weeks, the responsible office is Linden, and the file reference is H369/16.
2. Variation
No variation of this Agreement shall be effective unless it is made in writing and signed by an authorised representative of each
party, and no failure to exercise a right shall operate as a waiver of that right. For the purposes of clause 2 the reference period is
15 weeks, the responsible office is Harrowfield, and the file reference is D416/36.
3. Intellectual property
All intellectual property created by the Supplier in the course of the Services shall remain with the Supplier, and the Client is
granted a non-exclusive licence to use it for its internal business purposes. For the purposes of clause 3 the reference period is 13
weeks, the responsible office is Tarnwick, and the file reference is D455/57.
4. Insurance
The Supplier shall maintain adequate insurance against its liabilities under this Agreement and shall produce evidence of that
insurance on request, not more than once in any period of twelve months. For the purposes of clause 4 the reference period is 28
weeks, the responsible office is Tarnwick, and the file reference is G572/81.
5. Notices
Any notice under this Agreement shall be delivered by hand or sent by recorded post to the address stated above, and shall be
deemed received on the second working day after posting. For the purposes of clause 5 the reference period is 19 weeks, the
responsible office is Moorgate, and the file reference is C977/93.
6. Access and co-operation
The Client shall provide access to its premises and records at such times as the Supplier may reasonably request, and shall ensure
that its staff give all co-operation needed for the Services to proceed on schedule. For the purposes of clause 6 the reference
period is 9 weeks, the responsible office is Tarnwick, and the file reference is A717/60.
7. Standard of service
The Supplier shall carry out the Services with reasonable care and skill and in accordance with the Schedule, and shall keep the
Client informed of any matter likely to delay the Services by more than five working days. For the purposes of clause 7 the
reference period is 11 weeks, the responsible office is Saltmarsh, and the file reference is C297/31.
8. Confidentiality
Each party shall keep confidential all information of a commercial nature which it receives from the other, and shall use that
information only for the purpose of performing its obligations under this Agreement. For the purposes of clause 8 the reference
period is 3 weeks, the responsible office is Linden, and the file reference is D558/91.
9. Events beyond control
Neither party shall be liable for any failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control, provided that it gives
prompt written notice and takes all reasonable steps to resume performance. For the purposes of clause 9 the reference period is
26 weeks, the responsible office is Tarnwick, and the file reference is A723/41.
10. Variation
No variation of this Agreement shall be effective unless it is made in writing and signed by an authorised representative of each
party, and no failure to exercise a right shall operate as a waiver of that right. For the purposes of clause 10 the reference period is
34 weeks, the responsible office is Linden, and the file reference is E806/85.

11. Intellectual property
All intellectual property created by the Supplier in the course of the Services shall remain with the Supplier, and the Client is
granted a non-exclusive licence to use it for its internal business purposes. For the purposes of clause 11 the reference period is
23 weeks, the responsible office is Saltmarsh, and the file reference is F655/56.
12. Insurance
The Supplier shall maintain adequate insurance against its liabilities under this Agreement and shall produce evidence of that
insurance on request, not more than once in any period of twelve months. For the purposes of clause 12 the reference period is 32
weeks, the responsible office is Moorgate, and the file reference is A933/22.
13. Notices
Any notice under this Agreement shall be delivered by hand or sent by recorded post to the address stated above, and shall be
deemed received on the second working day after posting. For the purposes of clause 13 the reference period is 21 weeks, the
responsible office is Linden, and the file reference is G358/40.
14. Access and co-operation
The Client shall provide access to its premises and records at such times as the Supplier may reasonably request, and shall ensure
that its staff give all co-operation needed for the Services to proceed on schedule. For the purposes of clause 14 the reference
period is 29 weeks, the responsible office is Saltmarsh, and the file reference is H696/42.
15. Standard of service
The Supplier shall carry out the Services with reasonable care and skill and in accordance with the Schedule, and shall keep the
Client informed of any matter likely to delay the Services by more than five working days. For the purposes of clause 15 the
reference period is 11 weeks, the responsible office is Port Selwyn, and the file reference is F268/16.
16. Confidentiality
Each party shall keep confidential all information of a commercial nature which it receives from the other, and shall use that
information only for the purpose of performing its obligations under this Agreement. For the purposes of clause 16 the reference
period is 19 weeks, the responsible office is Linden, and the file reference is B835/16.
17. Events beyond control
Neither party shall be liable for any failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control, provided that it gives
prompt written notice and takes all reasonable steps to resume performance. For the purposes of clause 17 the reference period
is 40 weeks, the responsible office is Tarnwick, and the file reference is E637/89.
Termination
Either party may terminate on 90 days written notice.
Signed for Vellacott Tool & Die:
Name: Ilse Warrender, Director
fields: Either party may terminate on 90 days written notice.
